verses.text: Ay jun k'u t'a yol uj Nisán, ayik 20 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal, ayik wan wak'an swino winh rey chi', ix yilan winh to kuseltak yilji in sat. Malaj b'aj icha chi' wiljitaxoni.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winh t'ayin: --¿Tas yuj kuseltak yilji a sat? Ina manh ach penaokay swila'. Ichato ilk'olal aji, xchi winh rey chi'. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix in xiwk'ei,

ix walan t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, ayokab' achnhej eq'ui. ¿Tas yuj manh kuseltakok yilji in sat a naani, ina to a in chonhab' b'aj mukan heb' in mam wicham, emnak lanhnajok, tz'anakpaxb'at spuertail? xin chi t'a winh.
--¿Tas swutej in kolwaj t'ayach tiknaik jun? xchi winh rey chi'. Yuj chi' ix in lesalwi t'a sDiosal satcha'anh.

Ix walan t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Tato scha a k'ol mamin rey, tato wach' in t'a yol a sat, tzin k'an t'ayach to tzin a chab'at t'a Judá chi', b'aj mukan heb' in mam wicham, yik sb'at in b'oanxik'ei, xin chi t'a winh.

k'ojanem winh rey chi', k'ojanpaxem ix reina t'a stz'ey winh. Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: --¿Jantak tiempo tzach b'at jun? ¿B'aq'uinh tzach jaxi? xchi winh. Ix walani jantak tiempo, ix schaan sk'ol winh tas ix wal chi'.

Ix walanpax t'a winh icha tik: Tato wach' tz'aj tza na' mamin rey, ak'b'at junok karta t'a heb' winh gobernador ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates, yik wach' tzin schaek' heb' winh ta' masanto tzin k'och t'a Judá.

Sb'at junokxo karta chi' t'a winhaj Asaf yilumal te' niwak te' ay ta', yik syak' te' winh t'ayin, yik tz'och te' t'a spuertail b'aj ay heb' stanhwan templo, t'a smuroal chonhab' chi' yet' t'a te' pat b'aj ol in ajok, xin chi t'a winh. Yuj swach'k'olal in Diosal, ix yak' masanil juntzanh tik winh rey chi' t'ayin.

Ayik ix in jawi t'a heb' winh ayoch yajalil t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates chi', ix wak'an jun karta ix yak'kot winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh. Ajun pax juntzanh heb' winh yajal heb' soldado yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej ix yak'kot winh rey chi' wet'ok.
Palta haxo ix yab'an winhaj Sanbalat aj Horón yet' winhaj Tobías yajal yaj t'a Amón to ix in jawi yik tzin kolwaj yet' heb' wetisraelal, ix kot yowal heb' winh.
Ayik yoxilxo k'ual in jawi t'a Jerusalén,

in k'e waan t'ak'walil yet' jaywanh heb' winh winak ajun wet'ok, palta malaj junok mach b'aj ix wala' tas ix yal Dios t'a in pensar yuj tas ol in k'ulej t'a Jerusalén chi'. Malaj nok' chej ix kik'b'ati, a innhej ix wik' nok' in kuchumal.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', onh elta t'a jun puerta t'a panhan, t'a stojolal sjaj ha' Dragón, onh ek' t'a spuertail b'aj sb'atkan k'alem. Ix wilan smuroal Jerusalén chi', mak'b'ilem lanhnajok, tz'anakpaxb'at spuertail.
Ix ek' wilanpax jun puerta t'a sjaj ha ha' yet' pax stanke winh rey. Majxo yal-laj wek' yet' nok' in chej chi' ta'.
Anheja' k'ik'to in k'ek'och t'a sti' ha' Cedrón. Ayik ix lajwi wilan muro chi', in meltzajxi b'aj in b'at chi', in ochxi t'a jun puerta t'a panhan chi'.

Ha heb' yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi', manh yojtakok heb' b'ajtil ayinb'ati, manh yojtakok pax heb' tas tzin k'ulej. Malaj pax tas swal t'a heb' wetisraelal, t'a heb' sakerdote, t'a heb' yajal yaji yet' t'a heb' ol munlajok.

Ixlajwi chi' ix walan t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha ex tik eyojtak sik'lab'il to a jun pekti' b'aj ayonh ek' tik te chuklaj, ina ix mak'chajem lanhnaj chonhab' Jerusalén tik, tz'anakxopaxb'at spuertail. Yuj chi' ko molb'ejek ko b'a sko b'oanekxik'e smuroal tik, yik wach' maxtzak onh b'uchji, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ayik ix walan t'a heb' jantak swach'k'olal Dios ix sch'ox t'ayin yet' tas ix yal winh rey t'ayin, ix yalan heb': --Ko yamekoch ko munlaji, xchi heb'. Icha chi' ix aj skuchb'an sb'a heb' t'a jun munlajel chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Sanbalat aj Horón yet' winhaj Tobías yajal yaj t'a Amón yet' pax winhaj Gesem árabe, ix te b'uchwaj heb' winh t'ayonh, ix yalan heb' winh: --¿Tas ol he k'ulej? ¿Tom tze nib'ej tzeyik'el he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey? xchi heb' winh.

Ix in tak'wi t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Yuj skolwal sDiosal satcha'anh, ol yal kuuj. Ha onh schekab' onh tik ol ko yamoch ko b'oani, palta a ex tik, malaj eyalan eyik t'ayonh, malaj eyopisio, yujto manh ex ketchonhab'ok, xin chi.
